name: Brawler

tenures.role: commissioner; listed on the singles roster, wrestling only "in absolute, dire situations"
tenures.finisher: Spinal Fusion (tombstone piledriver off the top turnbuckle)
tenures.source: the fed's own profile/application page (promotions/xwf-2001/archive/brawler.html), its Fictional Staff page (promotions/xwf-2001/archive/fictional-staff.html) and its Singles Roster (promotions/xwf-2001/archive/singles-roster.html)
tenures.note: The profile page is the fed's own application form filled in. The fed's own staff page bills him a three-time IEA Tag Team champion and North Atlantic Champion, and his entrance video recites the same titles as "2 Time IEA Tag Team Champion". The two counts disagree in the fed's own text and neither is resolved here. IEA itself is not a promotion this collection holds.

identity.note: A bare-word ring name. Shares the generic word "Brawler" with three unrelated registered characters (extremely-hardcore-brawler-rspwf, eh-brawler-agw, brooklyn-brawler-newf) and with the fed's own application form's own style prompt ("STYLE(Brawler, Aerial, Mat Technician, etc.)"); nothing in any of their records connects them. Also NOT a portrayal: the fed's own profile likens him to two real professional wrestlers ("a black version of Kevin Nash", contact lenses making his eyes white "like Rey Mysterio's") — resemblance-as-description, never a claim to be either man, per the resemblance-is-not-a-portrayal doctrine.

caption: Commissioner of the XWF and the one name on its singles roster with a profile page of its own: seven feet, 280 pounds out of Phoenix, out of the ring by choice and promising to come back to it for anyone who got out of line.

name: Kevin Taylor

identity.note: Shares its surname with the unrelated registered character taylor-xr-ewa (billed "Taylor"); a common surname, no document connects the two.

caption: The XWF's senior interviewer, written as a lifer who worked his way up to the big time — and, by the fed's own first rule, one of only a few people a handler's roleplay was permitted to use.

name: Fred Johnson

caption: An XWF interviewer written as his colleague's stepbrother, out to outdo him by taking the assignments nobody else wanted — the wrestlers, in the fed's own words, blurring the line between sanity and delusion.
